comments.text: The part that stuck with me: a square metre of ocean gives up about a litre of water a day, while a square metre of Amazon forest gives roughly eight times that. The canopy is effectively a pump, and the Andes turn the flow south so Peru, Brazil, Paraguay, northern Argentina and Uruguay get the rain. Sources are listed in the description if you want to read further. Where you live, does the rain arrive off the sea or off the land, and do you know which way your prevailing wind comes from?
